content:
{
  "phoneNote": "The oversized contact header pushes the bakery imagery down, while repeated address and opening-hours sections make the page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The warm typography and prominent bread photography feel bakery-specific, but the duplicated contact section weakens an otherwise cohesive layout.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 4,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 5,
    "spacing": 4,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Keep one consolidated contact section with address, directions and opening hours; reduce the footer to business identification and legal links.",
    "On phone, compress the header to logo and menu, relying on the required fixed bar for call and directions actions so the bread photograph appears earlier.",
    "Make the bakery location readable near the hero headline, and give mobile product names more width by placing prices beneath them rather than squeezing both into one row."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "On phone and desktop, the footer repeats the address, directions and full opening-hours block immediately after the main contact section."
  ]
}
